checks.name: runtime_identity
checks.summary: Runtime identity matches the Fresh 30H-v3 seal.

checks.name: actual_start_end_and_duration
checks.summary: Actual timestamps and supervisor duration satisfy the sealed runtime duration.

checks.name: component_exit_codes
checks.summary: Collector, archive scheduler, and publisher all started and exited cleanly.

checks.name: systemd_result_and_restarts
checks.summary: Systemd reports success, zero restarts, and zero main-process exit status.

checks.name: terminal_witness
checks.summary: Terminal witness is clean and bound to the sealed run.

checks.name: collector_lifecycle
checks.summary: Collector reached COMPLETE and flushed final manifests.

checks.name: queue_persistence_and_writer
checks.summary: Final queue, unpersisted records, writer errors, and drops are zero; backpressure is reported.

checks.name: active_active_dedup_and_conflicts
checks.summary: Two Bithumb sockets were active, deduplication was enabled, and no conflicting duplicate was observed.

checks.name: qualifying_cohorts_and_feed_counts
checks.summary: Every sealed qualifying cohort has exactly one passing receipt with the expected slot count.

checks.name: all_feed_slots_and_receipts
checks.summary: Every sealed feed slot has exactly one valid local coverage receipt.

checks.name: local_s3_receipt_hash_equality
checks.summary: Local and S3 receipt mirrors match byte-for-byte.

checks.name: receipt_immutability
checks.summary: Every local receipt retained the same hash across observations.

checks.name: evidence_hash_index
checks.summary: Every indexed evidence file matches its SHA-256.

checks.name: scheduler_retries
checks.summary: No scheduler retries were observed.

checks.name: finalizer_retries
checks.summary: No finalizer retry events were observed.

checks.name: recovery_invocations
checks.summary: No recovery invocation was observed.

checks.name: duplicate_finalization
checks.summary: No feed slot was finalized more than once.

checks.name: closed_at_utc_stability
checks.summary: Repeated finalizations preserve closed_at_utc.

checks.name: finalization_evidence_hash_stability
checks.summary: Repeated finalizations preserve evidence hashes.

checks.name: restart_idempotency_path
checks.summary: The known restart-sensitive finalizer path was not exercised.
